name: Four Seasons Resort Mauritius
positioning: Luxury resort on the east coast of Mauritius, where villas have private pools
best_for: Travelers who want a villa with its own plunge pool
Golfers who want two golf courses to play
Families who want a supervised kids' program

facts.text: The resort is on Coastal Road, Beau Champ, Mauritius.
The resort is perched on the edge of the island's eastern coast and bordered by lagoon and ocean.
Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport is 45 minutes by car from the resort.
The resort has four outdoor pools.
Radici is a contemporary Italian trattoria.
Awase serves Japanese-inspired pan Asian cuisine.
The Oseyan Spa is perched on wooden pillars above the Indian Ocean.
The resort has two tennis courts.

highlights.text: Every villa has its own plunge pool.
Four Seasons guests have an exclusive beach on Île aux Cerfs.
Guests can play on an oceanfront Ernie Els-designed 18-hole golf course.
Non-motorized water sports are complimentary for all guests.
The Kids For All Seasons program is supervised and based at the Hobbit Village Kids' Club.

considerations.text: The exclusive beach on Île aux Cerfs is a short boat ride from the resort.
Port Louis and the seaside village of Grand-Baie can both be reached in around an hour.
Fees apply for helicopter transfers from the airport to the resort's helipad.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
